title: Linear elliptic PDE: solvability, regularity and spectral theory
abstract: A reusable analytic development of linear uniformly elliptic divergence-form PDE on Euclidean domains: Hilbert graph models of H¹ and H₀¹, bounded coefficient operators, Poincaré inequalities, zero-drift/nonnegative-potential Dirichlet existence and uniqueness, Gårding and Fredholm theory for general drift, interior H² and higher Sobolev regularity, smooth classical representatives, Sobolev and Hölder embeddings, C¹-domain extension and compactness, variational eigenvalues, and maximum principles. AI-generated proofs with human mathematical design and transcription; announced in arXiv:2609.32561 on 2026-09-26. The unfinished boundary-H² program is outside this completed dependency closure.

informal.EllipticPdes.Sobolev.FullEllipticOp.weak: On a bounded domain in positive dimension, a bounded measurable uniformly elliptic operator with zero drift and nonnegative zeroth-order coefficient has a unique H₀¹ weak solution for every L² datum, with a datum-independent norm bound.
informal.EllipticPdes.Regularity.interior_H2_esti: In positive dimension, on an open measurable domain, an H₀¹ weak solution of a bounded measurable uniformly elliptic divergence-form operator with globally Lipschitz principal coefficients and an L² datum has interior L² second weak derivatives, with an estimate whose constant is chosen before the solution and datum.
informal.EllipticPdes.Regularity.higher_interior_: In positive dimension, for a uniformly elliptic divergence-form operator with bounded measurable coefficients, globally Lipschitz principal-coefficient representatives in W^{k+1,∞}(ℝ^d), and lower-order coefficients in W^{k,∞}(ℝ^d), every H₀¹ weak solution on an open measurable domain with an H^k datum has interior H^{k+2} regularity. On each compact subset the iterated L² derivative bounds have a constant chosen before the solution, datum and its H^k bound. The pointwise Lipschitz hypothesis is separate from the weak-derivative bundles.
informal.EllipticPdes.Sobolev.embL2_isCompact: The inclusion H₀¹(Ω) → L²(Ω) is compact for bounded measurable Euclidean domains, discharging the compactness input to the Fredholm and spectral results.
informal.EllipticPdes.Extension.exists_extW12: In positive dimension, bounded open Euclidean domains with C¹ boundary admit a bounded linear H¹ extension operator with compact support control.
